required_changes_injected: CRITERION 3 FAILURE — Competition section contains non-approved competitors. Airship and Extreme Push are not on the approved competitive list (LaunchDarkly, Statsig, EPPO, Datadog Experiments, Optimizely, homegrown/internal). The analysis correctly flags this as a scope risk, but then scores Competition at 5/10 without resolving whether these competitors should be included in the assessment at all. The rubric requires: 'FAIL if competitor not in this list: LaunchDarkly, Statsig, EPPO, Datadog Experiments, Optimizely, or homegrown/internal tools.' Airship and Extreme Push violate this rule. REQUIRED FIX: Either (1) remove Airship and Extreme Push from the Competition assessment and rescore based only on Optimizely and Firebase, or (2) explicitly document in the analysis that these are out-of-scope competitors and adjust the score to reflect that only Optimizely is a valid competitive threat. Current score of 5/10 is not justified given the presence of non-approved competitors without explicit disqualification language.
